scenes.text: A recruiter's first look at a résumé lasts 7.4 seconds, and 84% of developers use or plan to use AI tools. So every GitHub looks impressive. Real builders get filtered out by keywords, hackathon wins are taken on trust, and 74% of Indian recruiters say qualified talent got harder to find.
scenes.say: A recruiter's first look at a résumé lasts seven point four seconds, and eighty-four percent of developers use, or plan to use, AI tools. So every GitHub looks impressive. Real builders get filtered out by keywords, hackathon wins are taken on trust, and seventy-four percent of Indian recruiters say qualified talent got harder to find.

scenes.text: Nobody asks: do you understand the code you're showing? Proofolio does. Students answer five questions about their own code, and get matched on verified skills, interests and hackathon performance.
scenes.say: Nobody asks: do you understand the code you're showing? Proof-olio does. Students answer five questions about their own code, and get matched on verified skills, interests and hackathon performance.

scenes.text: Here's the live app. Gemini reads claimed skills from a résumé, and a hackathon win, like our team's at ARGONYX '26, stays a claim until a viva verifies it.
scenes.say: Here's the live app. Gemini reads claimed skills from a résumé, and a hackathon win, like our team's at Argonyx twenty-six, stays a claim until a viva verifies it.

scenes.text: Proofolio reads the repo and asks about real lines of code. On this team repo, only about the files this student changed.
scenes.say: Proof-olio reads the repo and asks about real lines of code. On this team repo, only about the files this student changed.

scenes.text: Answer out loud or typed, in any language. We score understanding, not accent, and a vague answer gets one follow-up.
scenes.say: Answer out loud or typed, in any language. We score understanding, not accent, and a vague answer gets one follow-up.

scenes.text: Every score comes with evidence: their own words beside the code. Claims they didn't show count for nothing. The hackathon is now verified.
scenes.say: Every score comes with evidence: their own words beside the code. Claims they didn't show count for nothing. The hackathon is now verified.

scenes.text: The match is a plain formula: 60% verified skills, 25% interests, 15% verified hackathons. With consent, the recruiter sees the applicant arrive, ranked, with every answer beside its code.
scenes.say: The match is a plain formula: sixty percent verified skills, twenty-five percent interests, fifteen percent verified hackathons. With consent, the recruiter sees the applicant arrive, ranked, with every answer beside its code.

scenes.text: One FastAPI service on Cloud Run runs every AI step for the web app, dashboard and Android app. Questions are checked against real files; in our tests, repeat scoring never moved more than a point.
scenes.say: One Fast A.P.I. service on Cloud Run runs every A.I. step for the web app, dashboard and Android app. Questions are checked against real files; in our tests, repeat scoring never moved more than a point.

scenes.text: Students use it free: one viva, reused on every application. Companies get fewer, better interviews, and pay ₹2,999 per role, the price of one Internshala listing. Placement cells pay per batch, platforms like Promtal per candidate, and a viva costs us about ₹6 in AI.
